## [3.0.0](https://github.com/Sylonin/xposed-newx-patches/compare/v2.1.0...v3.0.0) (2026-11-01)

### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* X 12.34.0 to 12.38.1 are no longer supported targets. Patch the 12.39.0-prod.01 APKM instead.

### ✨ New Features

* support X 12.39.0-prod.01 only ([f30938d](https://github.com/Sylonin/xposed-newx-patches/commit/f30938dc2f9ae516a7ed1446b3bfc8c177048b07))

patches.name: Account location badges
patches.description: Shows X-Posed style country badges next to names and highlights or hides posts from chosen countries, without reporting passive engagement with them. Data comes from the X-Posed community cache, falling back to X's "About this account". Tap a badge for account details and settings.
